Overview.Name: Rajeshwari Yellati
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results, avoids non-veg on Thursday, Friday and Saturday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Thursday, Friday and Saturday and follow vegetarian options.
Reduce fried and highly processed foods to help lower joint inflammation.
Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Get regular sunlight exposure in the morning to support joint health, mood and recovery.
Consistent yoga, hydration and lighter dinners will improve energy and mobility over time.
